transcript.content: Hello, I'm Dr. Smith. It's nice to meet you; could you tell me what brings you in to see me today?

...Hi. Um... I guess I'm here because of what happened at work. 

We had a staff meeting and... I don't know, I just got real worked up. I started acting out this whole fall-prevention drill. Just... moving chairs around, waving my arms. Folks kept telling me to sit down, but... I couldn't seem to stop doing it. So... yeah. That's why I'm here.
Have you noticed any significant changes in your overall mood or energy levels that have lasted for several days or longer, rather than just during that meeting?

...I guess so. Sometimes. 

There are these stretches where I just feel... I don't know, real fired up. Bright, I guess. Like everything is finally lining up. But... well, if somebody slows me down, or starts questioning me... I snap at 'em. Harder than I mean to. 

So... yeah. That's about it.
During these periods when you feel 'fired up,' have you ever felt like you were seeing or hearing things that others weren't?

...I mean... maybe. It's hard to explain. 

When I get all fired up like that... I'm usually only sleeping a few hours a night, getting all these big plans together in my head. But... yeah, sometimes I'd hear calls. Like someone calling for help on the floor, but... nobody was there. 

And... I don't know, I just got real sure my supervisor was setting traps for me. Trying to catch me out. 

I don't really like talking about that part.
Are there times when you feel like people are setting traps for you or you hear voices even when you are not feeling 'fired up' or having those high-energy stretches?

...Yeah. I guess so. 

There was a time... a while back. I wasn't all worked up. I was sleeping okay, not doing all those projects. Just... normal, mostly. 

But... I still heard it. People calling my name when nobody was around. And... I just knew folks at work were taking notes on me. Watching me. That lasted for a few weeks, even when I felt calm. 

...I try not to think about it too much.
Outside of those 'fired up' periods and the times you felt watched, have you experienced any long stretches where you felt persistently sad, hopeless, or lacked the energy to do anything at all?

...No. Not really. 

I mean, I get down sometimes, like anybody. But... not like what you're saying. Not for long stretches where I can't do anything. 

...I mostly just keep working.
When you experienced those feelings of being watched and heard those voices while you were feeling calm, how many weeks did that last?

...Just... several weeks, I guess. 

It was a calmer stretch. I was sleeping more normally, wasn't rushing around with projects. But... yeah, for several weeks I still heard my name being called. And I stayed convinced people at work were keeping notes on me. 

...I didn't keep track of the exact days. That's all I really remember.
During the times you felt 'fired up,' did you ever experience a period lasting at least two weeks where you felt deeply depressed, lost interest in everything, or felt like you couldn't function?

...No. I already said I don't really get like that. 

Even when I was... you know, fired up... I wasn't sad or anything. I just... I don't get those long stretches of feeling hopeless. 

...I just keep moving.
When you have those 'fired up' periods where you are sleeping less and making big plans, how long do those stretches typically last?

...Well. They come and go, I guess. 

...It's been happening for... maybe about 11 months now. Where I get like that. Too much energy, not really sleeping. 

...But yeah, almost a year of it just... coming and going.
